title: JSPX 3.0 complete modernization
description: Modernize all 171 Java sources to Kotlin; support arbitrary HTML; comprehensive measured tests; current pinned dependencies; robust parsing; external TypeScript bundle; framework-independent styling; secure runtime; editor-ready metadata. Preserve and characterize existing lifecycle, controls, binding, AJAX, validators, templates, data and export behavior. Demo and VS Code extension are follow-up work.
acceptance_criteria: No production Java; full behavioral migration matrix; reproducible build; Kotlin and browser coverage gates; security regression tests; packaged assets; documented breaking changes.

title: Characterize all 171 legacy Java sources and migration surfaces
